**Vascular dementia codelist (CPRD Read codes)**

**Core codes**

| Read code | Term |
|:--|:--|
| E004 | Arteriosclerotic dementia |
| E004-1 | Multi-infarct dementia |
| E0040 | Uncomplicated arteriosclerotic dementia |
| E0041 | Arteriosclerotic dementia with delirium |
| E0042 | Arteriosclerotic dementia with paranoia |
| E0043 | Arteriosclerotic dementia with depression |
| E004z | Arteriosclerotic dementia NOS |
| Eu01 | Vascular dementia |
| Eu01-1 | [X]Arteriosclerotic dementia |
| Eu010 | Vascular dementia of acute onset |
| Eu011 | [X]Multi-infarct dementia |
| Eu011-1 | [X]Predominantly cortical dementia |
| Eu012 | Subcortical vascular dementia |
| Eu013 | Mixed cortical and subcortical vascular dementia |
| Eu01y | [X]Other vascular dementia |
| Eu01z | [X]Vascular dementia, unspecified |

**Borderline codes: include depending on your study**

| Read code | Term | Comment |
|:--|:--|:--|
| F21y2 | Binswanger's disease | Damage to the brain's white matter from small-vessel disease (also called subcortical arteriosclerotic encephalopathy). It's usually counted as a type of vascular dementia, but CPRD files it under demyelinating disease |
| F21y2-1 | Binswanger's encephalopathy | As above |

**Codes I considered and left out**
- **G678, CADASIL** (an inherited small-vessel disease of the brain): it causes vascular dementia, but the code doesn't mean the person has dementia.
- **Eu002, [X]Dementia in Alzheimer's disease, atypical or mixed type**: this is coded as an Alzheimer's diagnosis. Add it only if your definition of vascular dementia includes mixed Alzheimer's/vascular dementia.

**How I searched:** I searched by term for vascular, arteriosclerotic, multi-infarct, Binswanger, subcortical, mixed, CADASIL (no matches), leukoencephalopathy, post-stroke and cerebrovascular dementia. I also searched by code for every code under Eu01, E004 and F21y.
